sampling_rule: Original 2 s post-window samples; counter-linked candidates additionally require sample time >= broadcast counter crossing +2 s; all samples stop before next candidate start -2 s. Counterless candidates retain the original gate.

limitations: Coordinates are image-house relative, not calibrated physical or canonical rink coordinates.
No delivery direction is inferred from house vertical position alone.
Camera-shot grouping prevents cross-cut merging but does not establish physical stone identity.
Candidate chronology is provisional; missing true throws can contaminate post-window boards.
A counter decrement is delayed delivery evidence, not a measured physical settle time; stable-source support remains required.
Stones outside accepted house views remain unobserved; no complete game state is claimed.
Official board diagrams are not used to choose source frames or detections.
